quotient_semantics: Primary quotient counts independent π-origin/effective-definition classes, while preserving empirically independent operational subconstraints inside a class. Therefore quotienting a shared π origin never erases the fact that different apparatus produce distinct residual evidence.

evidence_classes.quotient_witness: All six rows acquire their explicit π factor only after a nominally round observable is represented through the same classical Euclidean circle/cylinder size family (circumference/diameter, area/diameter, cylinder volume/diameter). S04 is purely a derived-size family; S03/S05/S06/S07 retain different empirical protocols after stripping, so their operational residuals are preserved inside this quotient class rather than counted as six independent witnesses for π.
evidence_classes.foundational_residual: A family of independently realized boundary/extent/enclosed-measure/transfer observables on nominally round engineered artifacts is mutually coherent within declared tolerances. The coherence, not the circle definition, is the pressure.

evidence_classes.quotient_witness: Mechanical indexing and electronic phase are independent apparatus, but the factor 2π is introduced by the same choice to coordinatize one completed cycle/turn in radians. The observable recurrence, fractional displacement and drift survive; 2π itself does not.
evidence_classes.foundational_residual: Repeatable cycles close and admit consistent fractional displacement/drift relations across mechanical and electronic protocols.

evidence_classes.quotient_witness: The 2π placement, sign and scale factors can be shifted by transform convention and by using cycles-per-second versus angular-frequency densities. The FFT reconstruction and Johnson-noise spectral comparison remain valid after consistent conversion, so π does not survive as a physical constant in this class.
evidence_classes.foundational_residual: Spectral decomposability and band-limited physical ratios survive, but there is no π-specific foundational pressure once conventions are quotiented.

evidence_classes.quotient_witness: Gaussian density and unbounded heat-kernel π factors arise from continuum integral normalization under selected coordinates/measure. NIST uncertainty guidance permits non-Gaussian models, while the thermal transient remains an empirical relaxation/spread phenomenon. Hence the normalization constant is removed and only the dynamical spread/relaxation constraint survives.
evidence_classes.foundational_residual: Localized perturbations exhibit reproducible scale/time relaxation and transport behavior independent of Gaussian amplitude normalization.

evidence_classes.quotient_witness: There is only one audited raw row in this primary class. Its π appearances mix angular-frequency convention with particular continuum eigenfunction/boundary representations; the empirical residue is the discrete, perturbable resonance spectrum and acoustic/microwave cross-channel agreement.
evidence_classes.foundational_residual: Bounded propagation supports stable discrete modes whose shifts track controlled state and agree across distinct measurement channels.

excluded_from_pi_specific_cross_domain_c.reason: Real spectral engineering survives, but all audited π placement in this class is removable by transform/frequency-coordinate convention; it creates no π-specific foundational pressure.

audit_note: The 9/14 figure is a quotient of explicit π-bearing representations under primary shared dependency, not a claim that 9 empirical protocols are unreal or useless.
